metadata.author: Kaby
metadata.description:
"A cozy, kid-friendly approach to collaborative, creative, and innovative problem-solving.” — Kirkus Reviews  For dreamers and future inventors aged 6+!  A grand quest with Louey & Chloe—where imagination takes shape—literally! This time, they will use the science of DNA to design and create a unique gift. The friends dream up something truly extraordinary. Can they create it? Of course they can, but how? What secrets will Nature reveal? What strange places will they travel to? Pom and Pima, Ulima and Ray, Abacus the 8th, and the goat to travel with—you know you’ve arrived on Marsimble. Science is beautifully woven into the story. With every chapter, the team explores Nature to invent the future. Each chapter adds something curious to the plot. Young listeners will love experiencing in a playful, story-driven way: fun of teamwork, brainstorming ideas, and above it all warmth of family and love. 
Creating for Yoto has been an incredible collaboration. My stories are brought to life by a professional narrator with many years of experience, whose voice captures the wonder and warmth that Marsimble deserves.
